methodNote: Second conservative #503 import. Only leaf categories or individual records whose source taxonomy and downloaded image both support the Chinese-style square-hole cash tradition are imported. Clearly circular holes and special rosette apertures are retained as related/held records rather than counted in the main corpus. Pseudo-aperture/unpierced square-frame issues remain includable under Scope v1.

families.title: Semirechye Chinese-cash imitations
families.zh: 七河地区中国式方孔钱仿铸系列
families.dateLabel: 7th–12th century source groups; individual records retain their own source dates
families.description: Regional Chinese-style cash imitations and local recasts preserved as a broad editorial family. Kaiyuan, Qianyuan, Dali, Huichang, Xining, Dading, Zhenglong and undeciphered source groups remain separate catalogue/source groups; they are not assumed to share one issuer or mint.
families.question: Each Chinese prototype/source group requires separate attribution, chronology and local-vs-imported adjudication; this family is a browsing umbrella, not one issuing authority.
